speaker: Wife
text: Look at this street... it's unrecognisable anymore. we lost everything.

speaker: Husband
text: I know. Old man Ahmed's cart... our bakery... all gone.

speaker: Wife
text: I found this in the rubble of what used to be our home. Our picture. A piece of what was ours.

speaker: Wife
text: But it's a piece we can rebuild from. A reminder. I won't let it go.

speaker: Husband
text: You know what. Let me try.

speaker: Wife
text: How can you fix what's shattered?

speaker: Husband
text: We won't just fix it. We can reimagine it. Make it better.

speaker: Husband
text: If we want to live, We start with what's left and build from it.

speaker: Wife
text: The cracks will still be there... but the picture is will be whole again.

speaker: Husband
text: It's a start. Let this remind you that even after everything we lost, we are still here, that's all what we need to restart.

speaker: Wife
text: You're right. Tomorrow... we start building our new home.
